summary: USCB Financial Holdings and its subsidiary filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of a Side Letter Agreement with Patriot Financial Partners, which owned 10.2% of the company's voting stock. The termination followed the resignation of Patriot's board representative. The agreement with another party, Priam, remains in effect. No financial terms, premiums, or transaction values were disclosed. The filing reflects a governance/relationship change rather than a special situation.
